🎬 Shorts Strategy · Lesson 2 of 3

The 3-Second Rule — and the Metric That Proves It

5 min read · Updated November 2026 · Free · Written for Kenya
Share: WhatsApp X Facebook Telegram LinkedIn

Every short-video app now shows you how many people rejected your video before it really started. Instagram calls it skip rate. YouTube calls it "swiped away". Most creators never look.

Each platform tests your video on a small group first. If they leave fast, the video stops travelling. That's why the first seconds matter more than everything after them.

Where to find your 3-second score

AppMetricWhat it tells you
InstagramSkip rate (Reel Insights)% who left within the first 3 seconds
YouTubeViewed vs swiped away (Studio)% who chose to watch instead of swiping
TikTokRetention graph (video analytics)The exact second people drop off
✗ MYTH

My Short got 5,000 views, so 5,000 people watched it.

✓ REALITY

Since March 2025, YouTube counts a Shorts view as soon as it starts playing or replays — no minimum watch time. The stricter number is now called engaged views, in Advanced Mode, and monetisation still uses engaged views. Look there to see who really stayed.

What a strong opening looks like

  • Frame 1 is the result or the action, not your face saying hello. Finished braids, the cake being cut, the engine starting.
  • Text on screen says the promise in a few words, so it works with sound off.
  • No logo intros, no 'welcome back', no slow zoom. Each spends your most valuable seconds on nothing.
  • Cut, don't fade. Hard cuts keep pace in the opening.
💡 What most creators miss

TikTok says finishing a longer video from beginning to end gets more weight than weaker signals. A 45-second video that people actually finish is a stronger signal than a 7-second one they swipe from — so the hook must earn the middle, not just the first second.

Example: a Nairobi salon

Version A opens on the salon sign and the client sitting down — high skip rate. Version B opens on the finished knotless braids swinging, text: "6 hours in 30 seconds". Same footage, re-ordered. The salon compares skip rate and keeps whichever opening wins.

📋 Hooks to adapt (Kenyan versions)
"KSh [AMOUNT] and this is what you get in [TOWN]."
"Fundi wangu charged me [AMOUNT] for this. Here's how to do it yourself."
"Stop [COMMON HABIT] if you want [RESULT]."
"[RESULT] in [TIME]. Watch."
"Nobody in [TOWN] is talking about this."
✅ Do this today
⚡ Quick check

Since March 2025, what does a YouTube Shorts 'view' count?

Public Shorts views now count every start or replay. 'Engaged views' is the stricter number — and the one YouTube still uses for monetisation.

🧠 Key takeaways
  1. Every app gives you a 3-second score — find it and track it.
  2. YouTube views count every play; check engaged views for the truth.
  3. Open on the result; explain after.
  4. A hook must earn the middle, because finishing counts.
